items.text: The autumn fundraiser raised $18,420 against a target of $15,000. Next year's committee has asked that the online donation widget be reviewed before the spring campaign.

Finance has confirmed that the payroll cutover for the Northern region takes effect on the pay period beginning 14 October. Employees in bands 3–5 will see the new mileage allowance reflected in that run, and the arrears adjustment for September will appear as a separate line. Payroll admins should continue to use the legacy timesheet export until the integration team confirms the reconciliation is clean. Any queries from staff should go to the shared payroll inbox rather than to individual team members.

Meeting notes — Hotel booking integration sync, 3 September

Present: Priya Raman (product), Tom Aldridge (engineering), Cass Wei (finance systems), Marion Okafor (travel ops).

Priya opened by walking through the revised booking flow. The main change is that the nightly reconciliation now pulls reservation totals from the supplier API before the ledger export runs, which removes the manual step Cass's team had been doing every morning.

Key points:

- Tom raised a rate-limit concern: the supplier API allows 60 calls per minute per property. With the current polling interval we sit at roughly 40, so there is headroom, but it should be monitored as more properties are onboarded.
- Cass asked that failed reconciliation runs raise a ticket automatically instead of an email to the ops list. Agreed; Tom will scope a small wrapper.
- Marion noted that the front desk occasionally gets a confirmation email with a missing guest name when the booking is made by a corporate travel assistant through the linked portal. This is a data mapping issue on the export, not the API.

Action items

| Owner | Item | Due |
|---|---|---|
| Tom | Reconciliation failure ticketing wrapper | 17 Sep |
| Cass | Confirm ledger field mapping for guest name | 10 Sep |
| Marion | Collect two sample corporate bookings with the issue | 12 Sep |

Next sync is 17 September at 10:00.
Per the travel policy, bookings over £900 require sign-off from the budget holder before the hotel reservation is confirmed.
The gala seating plan and the raffle allocation are stored in the shared drive under events/autumn-gala; the booking sheet is the source of truth.
Hotels booked through the corporate portal are automatically tagged with the cost centre, so the finance team no longer rekeys them.

Charity night — volunteer briefing (draft)

Thank you all for signing up for the Riverside Children's Trust quiz night on 22 November. We expect around 140 guests, so the venue capacity is comfortable but the car park is not — please encourage guests to use the shuttle from the station.

The running order is below. Doors open at 18:30, with the quiz starting promptly at 19:15 once the buffet has been cleared. If you are on the registration desk, the guest list will be printed and also shared on the tablet at the entrance; remember to check off walk-ins separately so we can reconcile the till at the end.

Raffle tickets will be sold during the first two rounds. Last year several people asked whether they could pay by card, and this year the terminal will be at the merchandise table. Please do not take cash for raffle tickets at the bar — it caused confusion last time.

If anyone needs to swap a shift, post in the volunteer channel by the Thursday before. We will confirm final numbers with the caterer on the Monday.
The payroll change request form must be submitted by the 15th of the month to affect the following run.
The venue's automated enquiry assistant sends a provisional hold number when you request availability online; keep the reference until the contract is signed.

Spec: Hotel booking confirmation export

The export produces a CSV of confirmed reservations for the downstream finance import. Each row maps directly to one reservation and carries the fields below. The importer expects UTF-8 with a header row and will reject the file if any required field is empty.

```
reservation_id   string  required
property_code    string  required
guest_name       string  required
check_in         date    required (ISO 8601)
check_out        date    required (ISO 8601)
room_type        string  optional
rate_gbp         decimal required
tax_gbp          decimal required
cost_centre      string  optional
source_channel   enum    required (direct | corporate | partner)
```

Notes on behaviour:

1. Reservations cancelled before the export window closes are excluded. Cancellations after export are handled by the finance team through a credit note.
2. The corporate channel occasionally supplies the guest name on a separate contact record. When this happens the export currently emits an empty guest_name and logs a warning to the reconciliation report; see the open ticket on the travel ops board.
3. Rounding follows the property's local currency settings before conversion. Rate and tax are reported in GBP; the conversion rate used is stored alongside the batch for audit purposes.

A sample of the first five rows for each property is written to the validation folder on every run so the ops team can spot-check the mapping without opening the full file.
